notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures.
description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Gaea's Cradle.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
